## Source: amazon-inspector (037d60346c2dcc73ec58c1a647cfa6ace5860a20a6808c2b570a20506e09777e)
The package tessivatts version 0.1.0 was scanned across 13 files with no indicators of installer-side harm. No install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or environment scraping, no filesystem persistence, no dropper or remote-fetch-and-execute pattern, and no silent-relay behavior were observed in the package contents.

## Source: kam193 (2d8e0f874c40346588bbb4f025cb9be6ac29dc2fc6b95de5b662ac2126a628a1)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
